Name: Floatstep
Description:
You touch a willing creature, causing its movements to be imbued with a magical grace that makes every step they take feel as light as a feather. The creature can use their walking speed to move up and down to any unoccupied space above or below, hovering in place at the end of their turn.

This spell is complex and fragile, if ended naturally or dismissed, the suspended creature floats down 10-feet per turn as an updraft prevents them from taking falling damage, yet if concentration is broken, the creature plummets down at a speed of 20-feet per turn. Due to the grace required for the spell, concentration checks are made with disadvantage.
